text: The Lord reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.
righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
and consumes his foes on every side.
before the Lord of all the earth.
and all the peoples see his glory.
those who boast in idols— worship him, all you gods!
and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, O Lord.
you are exalted far above all gods.
for he guards the lives of his faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
and joy on the upright in heart.
